# 1. VIDEO INPUT & CONTEXT

Receive a YouTube video URL, extract the video ID, and retrieve the video metadata used as context for comment analysis.

# 2. COMMENT RETRIEVAL

Retrieve top-level YouTube comments with pagination, normalize the data, and limit analysis to 40 comments to keep the demo fast and predictable.

# 3. HYBRID SIGNAL EXTRACTION

Each comment is first classified as Pain, Opportunity, or Irrelevant using a lightweight decision model.

Only relevant comments are sent to a generative LLM to produce a concise market signal.

Individual failures are recorded and skipped so one bad comment does not stop the full analysis.

# 4. REPORT & RESPONSE

Aggregate the results and return both a human-readable Markdown report and structured JSON for downstream automation.
